videos.title: Love Is In The Air! 1970-1979
videos.description: 3 hours of up-tempo feel-good songs about love - spanning the whole decade! Get your dancin' shoes on with The Jacksons, ABBA, Elton, Anita Ward & John Paul Young.

videos.title: Pat Sharp's Surely Not A Cover?
videos.description: In year order - Pat's list of 30 classic 70s anthems that were all covers. Including Rod Stewart, The Clash, Manfred Mann, John Lennon, Shirley Bassey & The Wurzels!

videos.title: Magic Moments! The 70s
videos.description: Experience the magic of the 70s, where every beat was a spell and every song a timeless enchantment.

videos.title: Derek Griffiths: Playschool Disco!
videos.description: The voice of many people's childhood, Derek Griffiths, presents 40 of those tunes people pestered their parents to buy, all top pop moments that still bring a smile and happy memories of school days.

videos.title: Magic Moments! The 70s
videos.description: Experience the magic of the 70s, where every beat was a spell and every song a timeless enchantment.

videos.title: Is This Really How They Started?!
videos.description: Most went onto bigger things - but how did it all start in the 70s? Here are 30 chart & video debuts from household names - some songs are brilliant, but some you might not know.

videos.title: Saturday Night's Alright!
videos.description: From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the party hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?

videos.title: Sally James' Girls On Top!
videos.description: Back in the day, being a woman in a macho world of pop meant you had to fight so much harder! So let's celebrate with those who made their mark from Annie and Elkie to Kim and Kate.

videos.title: Saturday Night's Alright!
videos.description: From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the party hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?

videos.title: 40 Songs That Make You Smile!
videos.description: Another 40 feelgood songs guaranteed to bring a smile, one way or another! Expect a bit of rock, a bit of pop, a bit of love and a good slice of cheese.

videos.title: Saturday Night's Alright!
videos.description: From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the party hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?

videos.title: Limahl's Never Ending Soundtracks!
videos.description: 2 decades of movie moments and classic pop hits from the 70s & 80s. Direct from the red carpet - Limahl is ready for his close-up!

videos.title: I'm Stone In Love With You!
videos.description: Crackling vinyl, shag carpets & lava lamp glows - this is how we loved in the 70s! Oh, James...

videos.title: Morning Has Broken!
videos.description: From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?

videos.title: It Could Only Happen in the 70s!
videos.description: Dodgy dancing, slightly inappropriate flirting, extreme close-ups, chest hair, huge afros and those crazy fashions. Playing 25 songs and videos that could only have been made in the 1970s.

videos.title: 1973 Unleashed!
videos.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1973!

videos.title: Tony Blackburn's 70s Glam Pop!
videos.description: Big singalong choruses and outrageous outfits and make-up, these were the guys and gals that set the style of the 70s, and our man with the musical plan, Tony Blackburn was there!

videos.title: 1973 Unleashed!
videos.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1973!

videos.title: Groovy Little Numbers! Top 25
videos.description: 25 laid-back songs from the first half of the decade - expect long hair, trippy vibes and a few leftover hippies from the 60s!

videos.title: Derek Griffiths' Cartoon Xmas!
videos.description: The voice of your childhood with 30 festive faves especially animated for Christmas! Including Brenda Lee, Beach Boys, Michael Buble, Elvis Presley and The Frog Chorus.

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready?

videos.title: Who Won Wot in 1970?
videos.description: Mark Goodier presents 1970s big music award winners. Find out which superstar singer won at the Oscars at the start of the decade and who got the keys to the City of Indiana.

videos.title: 1970 Unleashed!
videos.description: A music playlist featuring a selection of classic hits spanning the year 1970.

videos.title: The Best 1970 Party... Ever!
videos.description: Blimey, what a year! Get ready to turn your telly up LOUD, with the greatest party anthems from 1970 including The Jackson Five, Mungo Jerry, Black Sabbath, Free and Elvis Presley.

videos.title: Rosko's Hellraisers! Top 25
videos.description: A music video playlist presenting the biggest rock and roll rebels of the 1970s, presented by the man who was there for all of it, that groovy host from the West Coast, Radio 1 legend, Rosko.

videos.title: 1970 Unleashed!
videos.description: A music playlist featuring a selection of classic hits spanning the year 1970.

videos.title: Essentials! 70s Rock Groups
videos.description: Turn it up loud for 2 hours of proper rock from the 70s - the decade that gave birth to Prog and Metal! Including Pink Floyd, Led Zeppelin, Black Sabbath, Alice Cooper, AC/DC and Queen.

videos.title: NOW 70s presents NOW 60s!
videos.description: 5 hours of flashbacks from the swinging 60s! Including Johnny Cash, Sam Cooke, The Kinks, Lulu, The Beach Boys, The Beatles, The Troggs, Bob Dylan, The Rolling Stones & Elvis.

videos.title: Back To The 60s!
videos.description: We're going back to a time when Little Eva was telling everybody to do the loco-motion and The Beatles claimed they were the walrus. Expect to see all of your fave artists as we rewind to the 60s.

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready?

videos.title: Bruno Brookes-Never Even A Top 10?
videos.description: Bruno Brookes guides you through three hours of top tunes from superstars like Bowie, ABBA, Bob Marley, Queen, The Who and more.

videos.title: Retro Rewind! 70s Edition
videos.description: From hippies to punk rockers, via folk, funk, soul & disco - these are the classic songs that made the 70s!

videos.title: What? They Only Peaked at 11?
videos.description: Every one of these (mostly) classic tunes just missed the UK top-10. All of them got to number 11 and then no higher, including a brace each from Elton John and Queen.

videos.title: Disco Fever!
videos.description: Get on the love train with some top tunes to satisfy those boogie nights.

videos.title: Disco Bling! Top 25
videos.description: 25 of the campest and glitziest disco videos known to man. Sunglasses at the ready, because you'll be blinded by the bright lights and bling!

videos.title: Disco Battle! Boney M vs ABBA
videos.description: Get on the dance floor and see who has the biggest 70s disco beats between Boney M or ABBA.

videos.title: Tony's Sensational 70s Xmas!
videos.description: Tinsel Tony with tons of terrific tunes and festive fun for Christmas - all from the 1970s!

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready?

videos.title: Festive Faves! 70s v 60s v 50s
videos.description: Three decades of festive classics from Bing Crosby and Perry Como to Boney M and Paul McCartney.

videos.title: Clare Grogan's Teenage Kicks!
videos.description: The 5 years from '77 to '81 was possibly the most exciting and vibrant time to be a teenager and Clare Grogan was there - buying the records, seeing the bands and wearing the t-shirts!

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971!

videos.title: Michael & The Jacksons!
videos.description: Playing six mega party hits and a ballad from the Jackson family.

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971!

videos.title: Every Number 2 of 1971
videos.description: Runners-up from the UK charts in 1971 – 12 songs that didn't quite make it. Starting & ending with T.Rex, we keep up the class with Bridget The Midget & Tweedle Dum Tweedle Dee!

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971!

videos.title: American No.1s of 1971
videos.description: In order - 10 videos that hit the top of the US chart in 1971. Some are obvious, but there are a few surprises along the way!

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971!

videos.title: The NOW Yearbook 1971
videos.description: At the top of the charts '71 started with an actor in a rocking chair & ended with a comedian on a milk float! In between we had Elton, Elvis, Rod, Diana, Cher, Slade & many more!

videos.title: It's 1971 Night!
videos.description: All night - classic hits from just 1 year - 1971!

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready?
